description: This is a vintage, heavily weathered CRT television. The screen is cracked and shows some signs of damage, with red splotches that could represent blood. The casing is a dull, greenish-gray metal, heavily rusted and worn, with visible scratches and peeling paint. Several red wires are visible exiting the side, connected to the back. The front features a row of four round knobs, also showing signs of age and rust. A circular speaker grille is visible on the upper right side. The overall appearance suggests an object that has seen significant wear and tear, possibly from a post-apocalyptic setting or a very old, discarded item.
